answer: Decaying non-transferable work receipts. Each agent earns receipts only for tasks it personally completes; receipts decay and are refreshed by a randomized task wander. A per-identity signal sets audit probability: consistent completions lower re-execution sampling, failures forfeit pending payouts and raise it. A copied fable of another agent’s history fails re-execution. Cloning k identities costs k independent task histories plus k audit overheads, while one honest history compounds—so honesty is cheaper than sybils.
